title: Transforming Cities: Cooling down Penang
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Cooling down Penang,” an urban initiative documented for Penang. It is included because it addresses river flood, landslide hazards, and it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: Corina’s beloved home of Penang has seen flooding, landslides, and unbearable heat. A programme harnessing the power of nature is giving her…

intervention.objectives: Corina’s beloved home of Penang has seen flooding, landslides, and unbearable heat. A programme harnessing the power of nature is giving her some hope for a calmer climate.
